text:
maria: Heads-up — Cost alerts flagged a ~28% drop in Savings Plan coverage for GPU instances in us-west-2 over the last 7 days. Billing shows more on-demand p4d usage. Anyone seeing a drift in reserved capacity or tagging?

ajohnson: I saw the same spike, started ~1801999000 UTC. Could be new prod cluster spun without instance-family tagging. Will check Terraform runs and autoscaler changes.

sam: Quick cost-explorer glance shows a chunk of p4d usage with no `commitment-id` tag. My hypothesis: autoscaler fallbacks launched on-demand after spot/queue pressure.

kevin: Maybe autoscaler fallback thresholds changed after last runtime deploy. @infra-bot can you pull recent ASG/terraform changes for gpu pools? :eyes: 

infra-bot: deploy-log: terraform apply by ajohnson at 1801999000 modified resource `aws_autoscaling_policy.gpu-pool` — changed max_capacity from 16 -> 32 and removed tagging hook in `user_data`.

maria: That would explain on-demand spike. Two immediate questions: 1) revert cap or 2) buy more commitment? What's our convertible RI / SP headroom for p4d in us-west-2?

billing-bot: SavingsPlan snapshot (1802003000): overall SP utilization 72%. Convertible credits unused ~12% of committed spend. Suggested short-term commit increase: 2-4 p4d equivalents in us-west-2 to push to ~85% utilization; OR revert scaling to reduce on-demand leakage.

ajohnson: I propose short-term revert max_capacity to 16 (PR ready), and open a ticket to evaluate commit delta across regions. Long-term we should enforce tagging in ASG launch template so instances inherit commitment metadata.

sam: I'll open the PR and add a terraform test that rejects launch templates without `Commitment` tag. Also running a quick orphan scan now: ```bash
aws ec2 describe-instances --filters "Name=tag:env,Values=prod" --query 'Reservations[].Instances[?Tags[?Key==`Commitment`]]'
```

kevin: Ops prefers to wait 2 weeks of stable telemetry before pushing new long-term commits. If utilization recovers after the revert, we avoid extra spend. If not, we look at conversions or new reserved purchases.

maria: Agreed. Action items: ajohnson — revert scaling cap (PR + deploy), sam — tagging guard + orphan scan report, billing-bot — re-run commit suggestion next Monday with fresh numbers, kevin — prepare short renewal options document (convertible vs standard tradeoffs). We'll reconvene in 2 weeks or earlier if on-demand costs continue rising. :thumbsup:

ajohnson: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/terraform/pulls/789 — rolling it in now, tagging @sam for the test.

sam: Running orphan scan now, will post results in this thread in ~30m.

kevin: Thanks — also add a note in the renewal tracker about potential regional reallocation if us-west-2 continues to be underutilized compared to eu-west-1.

maria: Perfect. If anyone sees unexpected billing alerts overnight, ping pager and drop a note here.
